title: Nourishing Sweet Polish Plum Crumble
description: A macrobiotic-friendly dessert featuring robata-grilled plums and a crumbly topping, perfect for midnight cravings. This dish combines the sweetness of plums with the warmth of bay leaf.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Grill the sliced plums for 2 minutes on each side, until they develop a slight char.
In a large bowl, mix together the oats, almond flour, coconut sugar, and sea salt.
Add the chopped walnuts to the bowl and stir until they are evenly distributed.
In a small saucepan, melt the coconut oil over low heat.
Add the melted coconut oil to the bowl and stir until the mixture forms a crumbly topping.
In a separate bowl, mix together the grilled plums and bay leaves.
Transfer the plum mixture to a baking dish and top with the crumbly topping.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 minutes, until the topping is golden brown.
